learning_outcomes.text: Choose between Standard and Autopilot GKE and provision clusters and node pools
Deploy and manage workloads with Deployments, Services and Ingress
Configure requests, limits, probes and horizontal autoscaling
Secure clusters with RBAC, Workload Identity and network policy
Manage configuration, secrets, storage and stateful workloads
Operate, observe, upgrade and control the cost of production clusters

integrative_case: Operate a payments microservice on GKE: pick Autopilot or Standard, deploy with health probes and resource requests, expose it through Ingress with TLS, enforce Workload Identity and a network policy, autoscale against load, then plan a zero-downtime node upgrade and a cost review.
